name: FAS-Forge
description: "FAS-Forge is a benchmark for securing autonomous port selection in fluid antenna systems (FAS). It is built on measuredmassive MIMO channels of a dense indoor user-position sweep, which emulate a FAS aperture of 32 ports over 1.35wavelengths. For two propagation conditions (LoS and NLoS) and three data splits it provides the true port gains, cleanpilot reports, ten families of forged reports (random perturbation, white-box gradient attacks, candidate-aware andboost attacks, splicing, and replay), the parameters of a correlation-consistency gate, and an evaluation harness withreference defenses and a leaderboard at an equal probing budget. It supports research on adversarial robustness ofwireless control loops, physical-layer authentication, and measurement-based verification."
